title.zh: 热力学第一定律 · 状态与路径
title.en: First law of thermodynamics · state and path

description.zh: 气体吸收的热量 Q，一部分变成内能的增加 ΔU，其余推动活塞对外做功 W；内能只看状态，热和功却取决于走哪条路径，所以从同一起点出发的等温膨胀和绝热膨胀会走出不同的曲线。
description.en: Heat Q taken in by a gas partly raises its internal energy ΔU and partly pushes the piston to do work W; internal energy depends only on the state while heat and work depend on the path, which is why isothermal and adiabatic expansions from the same start trace different curves.

zh: 等温过程 绝热过程

label.zh: 卡诺循环由这些路径拼成
label.en: The Carnot cycle is built from these paths

reason.zh: 卡诺循环就是两段等温加两段绝热围成的回路；先用第一定律记清每一段的 Q、W、ΔU，才看得懂一圈下来净功为什么等于吸热减放热、效率为什么有上限。
reason.en: A Carnot cycle is two isothermal and two adiabatic legs closed into a loop; balancing Q, W and ΔU on each leg with the first law is what makes it clear why a full cycle’s net work is heat in minus heat out, and why its efficiency is capped.

label.en: Internal energy is the molecules’ kinetic energy

reason.zh: 理想气体的内能是大量分子动能的总和、只由温度决定，压强来自分子撞壁；所以等温过程内能不变，吸进来的热全部拿去做功。
reason.en: An ideal gas’s internal energy is the total kinetic energy of its molecules and depends only on temperature, while pressure comes from wall collisions; so in an isothermal process ΔU = 0 and all the heat taken in goes into work.

label.zh: 功是 P–V 曲线下的面积
label.en: Work is the area under the P–V curve

reason.zh: 体积变化一点点时功是 P·dV，把这些小条累加起来就是 W = ∫P dV——P–V 曲线下的面积；路径不同，面积不同，功也就不同。
reason.en: For each small change in volume the work is P·dV, and adding up those strips gives W = ∫P dV — the area under the P–V curve; a different path encloses a different area, so the work differs.
